description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ParserException' used within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the API parser exception handling. It extends RuntimeException and implements monitoring and response container interfaces, providing additional context such as error codes, request IDs, and HTTP response objects.

classes.name: ParserException
classes.description: A specialized exception class used for parsing errors in AWS API responses, including additional context such as error code, request ID, and response object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with message, code, previous exception, and additional context including error code, request ID, and response.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response object associated with the exception, if any.
